import html # Example placeholder template (adjust as needed) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {writer_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(writer_name: str, title: str, body: str, tag_list: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- writer_name : str The name of the post's author. title : str The headline of the user's post. body : str The primary text content of the user's post. tag_list : list[str] A collection of tags related to the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string containing the escaped post data. """ # Escape user‑supplied content to prevent XSS safe_writer = html.escape(writer_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body) # Build tags: each tag wrapped in a element safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list ) # Format the final HTML using the provided template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( writer_name=safe_writer, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
